parameters.content:
## Setup before testing
1. Validate Intake: set api_base_url for your host/container, real staff email, and staff draft calendar.
2. Anthropic Chat Model: select a model available to your account and verify credentials.
3. Verify Google Calendar, Gmail and Sheets credentials. Review_Queue points to the sheet created in this session.
4. Keep the inherited 0.50 threshold as a demo configuration, not a validated clinical threshold.
5. Use the updated sentient_api.py. Both HTTP nodes send original text and Boolean screening_complete.

## Routing
Emergency first; invalid intake responds with missing fields; unknown/incomplete screening goes to review.
Eligible intake → staff summary → summary check → MLP-64 → booking policy → draft for approval.
Missing information, low confidence, combined Cardio/Pulmonary, and failures go to review.

## Important limits
No per-case confidence intervals are produced by the API.
Google Calendar creates a real private event labeled DRAFT; it is not a confirmed appointment and availability is not checked.
Queue and staff notification run after/in parallel with the webhook response. Inspect execution outputs for delivery failures.
Repeated test requests may create duplicate rows/events. Use synthetic data and unique case IDs.
Live API/Claude/Google calls have not been verified by offline tests.
